name: Lyo.QRCode.QRCoder
tagline: `IQRCodeService` from `Lyo.QRCode` implemented with QRCoder. Pick this for JPEG / Bitmap on Windows, or for QRCoder's renderers.
description:
`IQRCodeService` from [`Lyo.QRCode`](../Lyo.QRCode/README.md) implemented with QRCoder. Pick this for JPEG / Bitmap on Windows or for QRCoder's
renderers. `BuiltInQRCodeService` is the in-library ISO encoder with no extra NuGet.

examples.title: Generate with QRCoder

sections.title: Types
rows: `IQRCodeService` implementation. No image dependencies. Logo, frame, caption, and padding are the caller's job through `Lyo.Images.IImageDecorationService`.

sections.title: Platform and decoration
items: JPEG / Bitmap go through `System.Drawing` and run on Windows. PNG/SVG paths are cross-platform.
`ReadFromImageAsync` decoding uses `QRCodeZxingRead` in this package (ZXing.Net + ImageSharp), matching the built-in service.

**Decoration is out of scope.** Center logos and frames are no longer applied by the QRCoder service. Send the returned bytes through `Lyo.Images.IImageDecorationService.Pipeline(...)` and call `Overlay` / `AddFrame` / `AddCaption` / `AddOuterPadding` as needed (see the [`Lyo.Images` README](../../Images/Lyo.Images/README.md)).
